name: [🌌] Steal Fish Eggs
desc:
🐟 Welcome to Steal Fish Eggs!

How to Play:
🟠 Steal fish eggs from fish
🐣 Hatch fish eggs to collect rare fish
💰 Earn money from your fish
🌊 Upgrade your endless pool and base
🫧 Train on the endless pool to gain swim Speed
🥷 Steal fish from other players
✨ Discover rarer fish eggs, fish, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Console and Mobile!
